NIH Salary Cap Summary (FY 1990 - Present)

Scope Note

Congress legislatively mandates a limitation on salary for individuals under NIH grant and cooperative agreement awards. The mandate appears in the annual appropriation act that provides authority for NIH to incur obligations for a given fiscal year (FY). The amount of salary that can be provided to an individual through grant and cooperative agreement funds cannot exceed Executive Level II of the Federal Executive Pay Scale (Office of Personnel Management Salaries & Wages).

For FY 1990 through FY 2024, the salary cap applied only to direct salaries. Beginning in FY 2025 (NOT-OD-25-025), the salary cap applies to both:

  • Direct salaries (individuals working directly on NIH projects).
  • Indirect salaries (executive salaries in various uncapped cost pools).
Tip: Want to learn more about using salary caps?
See NIH Salary Cap Calculations Examples.
